sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of five consecutive wins before a draw, and face an Alsager side rooted to the bottom with just 4 points and a concerning run of five losses in their last six matches.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford's recent draw suggesting they may be consolidating rather than pushing hard for the title. AFC Bridgnorth, third and on an impressive run before their most recent loss, host Eccleshall in an intriguing clash between two of the division's stronger performers. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals face struggling Wednesfield Community at home, with the visitors searching for consistency after an uneven recent record. Bilston Town, fifth and in-form, entertain Foley Meir in what should favour the visitors' form. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, a match between two sides in difficult form with New Mills suffering two consecutive defeats. Crewe face Allscott Heath, with the former struggling significantly at the bottom end while Allscott show more encouraging signs. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter between two sides with minimal points separating them. Shawbury United host Barnton, with the former in alarming form having lost five of their last six, whilst Barnton offer mid-table stability. Finally, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, with Widnes in dire straits at the foot of the table having picked up just 2 points from seven games.
